name: ad_script_exec_record
note: interprets one 4-byte script record [op,a,b,c]: 05 FPGA wr(reg=b,val=c); 06 AD wr(a:b,c; reg 0xA3 value patched from RAM 0x20000100); 08 AD rd; 0A poll AD reg((a&0xF)<<8|b) bit(c>>4)==(c&1), 300 tries; 0B delay c; others nop

name: init_fpga_config
note: FPGA cfg tables 0x08016260/0x08016460 -> FPGA regs 0..0xff (2 pages; page 2 sets reg 0xE9 = 0x03 on boards 2/4/5); then runs AD9363 script (see below) via 0x0800d318; then ENSM/lock status reads

name: fpga_extra_writes

name: channel_table_a

name: channel_table_b
note: 39 x 9 B; boards 6/7 (Artosyn AR8003); same MHz list 2404..2480; MHz/N 19.35-19.5 (different ref)

name: tcx_config_update1
note: TX attenuation update: boards 2/4/5 write AD9363 0x073/0x075 (TX1/TX2 ATTEN_0) when radio_state+0x11b differs from applied [0x20000167]; boards 6/7 write FPGA 0xCE and AD 0x054/0x05C. Writes NO RF-PLL regs. Guards: [+0x119]!=0, +0x11b != [0x20000167], FPGA reg 0xE9 bits 0 AND 1 set

name: fpga_cfg_load
note: writes FPGA regs 0x97-0x9b, 0x04-0x07.. from two structs; called from radio_start_stop and 0x080100ae

name: radio_config_apply
note: sets radio_state+0x84 = 3, then FPGA regs 0xBA-0xBE (boards 2/4/5) / 0xB8-0xBB (6/7) <- 9-byte channel table record [idx]; stores float at +5 to radio_state+0x94. Whether +0x84 is re-set before use elsewhere: UNKNOWN

name: tcx_tune_caller
note: only caller of tcx_config_update1; no direct BL caller (table/task)

name: tcx_config_power_zone
note: AD9363 TX attenuation / power zone writes

name: radio_start_chain
note: large init function (push.w {r1-fp,lr}); BL at 0x0801015a calls radio_config_apply (0x0800f436); also calls 0x0800f3d8 and 0x0800e820

name: radio_first_init
note: small: if [S+0x109]==0 call 0x0800bace, 0x0800bad4, set [S+0x109]=1. Does NOT call radio_config_apply

name: radio_start_stop
note: r0=1 start / 0=stop; guarded by [S+0x11a]==0 for start; calls 0x08010286, 0x0800f3d8, 0x0800e820, 0x08010092. That it touches no AD9363 register is NOT proven (indirect calls not followed)

name: radio_state_S
note: struct base. +0x0c cfg word (below); +0x84 channel index; +0x88 channel count(?); +0x94 channel MHz float; +0x109 first-init flag; +0x119 active; +0x11a started; +0x11b TX atten index (written to AD9363 0x073/0x075); +0x128/+0x12a/+0x12c set by 0x0913

name: radio_cfg_word
note: S+0x0c: bit21 fixed-channel flag (0x08010900); bits12-17 fixed channel idx (0x08010916); bits7-11 5-bit field (0x0801092c); bits18-20 3-bit field (0x08010942); bits27-29 3-bit field (0x08010968); bit31 compared in tcx_config_update1 to select atten values

name: applied_tx_atten
note: last applied value compared with S+0x11b by tcx_config_update1

name: channel_index_calc
note: if cfg bit21: S+0x84 = ((cfg>>12)&0x3f) % S+0x88; else hop: index advanced mod S+0x88 using sequence table at S+0x90 indexed by S+0x80&0x1f. Inferred hopper (not run)

name: packet_send
note: DUML tx

name: packet_make_response

name: duml_cmd_0912

name: duml_cmd_0914
note: radio status GET (reply 0x0964); sub-modes 0/4/5 compute from helpers (not decoded)

name: cmd_exec_set09_cmd05

name: cmd_exec_set09_cmd06

name: cmd_exec_set09_cmd07
note: DUML set 0x09 cmd 0x07: read counterpart of cmd 0x06 (hi==0xFE -> FPGA read, else ad936x_reg_sync_read); reply [0, val]

name: cmd_exec_set09_cmd12
note: DUML set 0x09 cmd 0x12 SET: calls radio_start_stop(0); b0 bit7 -> cfg bit21, b0&0x7f -> bits12-17; b1>>6 -> bits27-29; b1&0x3f -> bits7-11 (5-bit setter); b2 -> S+0x11b (TX atten idx); b3 -> bits18-20. Reply [0]. Does not itself call tcx_config_update1/radio_config_apply

name: cmd_exec_set09_cmd13
note: DUML set 0x09 cmd 0x13 GET: returns readback of the cmd 0x12 fields + float(0x0800be36)*10 u16 (8 bytes)

name: cmd_exec_set09_default
note: handler for keys 0x01 (set 0x09 and 0x13), builds 0x22-byte reply with board-dependent words from RAM 0x200000f4/0x200000f8

name: cmd_exec_key07_set00
note: table entries 0x07000009/0x07000013 share this handler (not decoded)

name: cmd_exec_set09_catchall

name: cmd_exec_set13_cmd08
note: key 0x08000013 (not decoded)

name: fpga_cfg_table_b

note: HSE on, FLASH 2 wait states, PPRE1 /2, PLLSRC=HSE PLLMUL x6, PLL on, SW=PLL; HSE_VALUE literal 0xb71b00 = 12 MHz => 72 MHz SYSCLK, PCLK1 36, PCLK2 72

name: rcc_get_clocks_freq
note: StdPeriph RCC_GetClocksFreq: out[0]=SYSCLK [1]=HCLK [2]=PCLK1 [3]=PCLK2 [4]=ADCCLK

name: uart_init
note: USART1 256000 8N1 (DMA1 ch4 TX buf 0x200001d0, ch5 RX 0x200002d0 512 B); USART2 250000 only if board==7; USART3 256000 8N1 (DMA ch2 TX 0x200007d0, ch3 RX 0x200008d0 256 B); RX IDLE-line IRQ framing

name: usart_init
note: StdPeriph USART_Init; BRR = int(25*clk/(4*baud)) split /100 and *16+50 /100; USART1 uses PCLK2 else PCLK1

name: uart_send
note: args (port 1/2/3, buf, len): copies into per-port TX FIFO then starts DMA (port1 buf 0x200001d0, port2 0x200004d0, port3 0x200007d0)

name: spi2_init
note: SPI2 master, 8-bit, CPOL0 CPHA1, soft NSS, BR /8 (4.5 MHz at PCLK1 36), MSB first; PB13/PB15 AF_PP, PB14 input, PB12 CS output high

name: can_init
note: CAN1: PA11 RX IPU, PA12 TX AF_PP, prescaler 3, SJW 1tq, BS1 6tq, BS2 5tq => 1 Mbit/s at PCLK1 36 MHz; ABOM+AWUM; called only if board in {2,4,5,6}

name: can_queue_init
note: (obj, std_id, is_tx, size, buf): ring for one CAN id; TX => table 0x200015d0+0x34, RX => exact-match filter (bank = RX count) + table 0x200015d0; callers 0x080113a8 (0x412 TX, 0x413 RX; board-gated) and 0x08011828 (0x414 TX, 0x415 RX; ungated)

name: can_enqueue_and_tx
note: enqueue bytes into queue obj then CAN_Transmit up to 8 B with StdId=obj[0] when TX idle

name: can_rx0_handler
note: CAN RX0 IRQ (vector 20): match StdId to queue objects, push bytes

name: usart1_irq
note: IDLE IRQ: stop DMA ch5, count = 0x200 - remaining, copy to RX FIFO, re-arm

name: usart3_irq
note: IDLE IRQ: same pattern, buffer size 0x100; pushes into ring at DAT_0800ae6c+0x64 (=0x2000007b) - drained by fpga_uart_to_fc_relay

name: usart2_irq
note: IDLE IRQ: same pattern as usart1_irq/usart3_irq; pushes into ring at DAT_0800ae6c+0x3c (=0x20000053), matches the pre-existing can413_pump board-7 USART2 note

name: fpga_uart_to_fc_relay
note: drains two rings (0x20000144 [src: FUN_0800e008, RF payload descrambler], 0x2000007b [src: usart3_irq, FPGA UART]) via duml_parser_feed; on complete frame, tail-calls send_usart1 directly - bypasses duml_dispatch entirely. Called every other tick from the main scheduler (0x080105da). See air-router-deep-dive.md §6a

name: fpga_link_payload_descramble
note: XORs 0x38 B against repeating 8-B key, two-stage chained checksum (FUN_08011e54, seed 0x55aa), on success updates radio-config field + pushes 0x1c B into ring 0x20000144 (fpga_uart_to_fc_relay's first ring). Sole caller: FUN_0800f978 (fpga_link_rx_poll). Key = radio_state_s+0x64 (0x20001b18), traced to a zero-fill boot RAM-init region, no writer found anywhere - key is always zero, XOR step is a no-op

name: fpga_link_rx_poll
note: polls spi_fpga_raw_read(0xe9) (FPGA status reg), branches on demod-lock state, calls FUN_0800f6a0 ("new frame?") then fpga_link_payload_descramble on the just-arrived frame. This is the live radio-link RX poll loop

name: duml_dispatch
note: walks 8-byte records at 0x0801a120 [handler,type,index,set,id] matching pkt[5] pkt[9] pkt[10]; no match => tail-call packet_send (forward)

name: packet_send_route_tbb
note: 31-byte tbb indexed by pkt[5]&0x1f: types 2,6,13,14,16,20,22 => uart_send(3); 1,4,8,15 => 0x0801141c; 3,5,10,11,12,18,21,23 => 0x08011938 (=> 0x0801261c uart_send(1), all boards); 17 => 0x0801195c (USART1 / board 7 path A); 30 => 0x0801190e (CAN 0x414 / board 7 USART1); others dropped

name: route_path_a
note: boards 2/4/5/6: CAN queue 0x20002330; board 7: type 8 idx 1 or 7 => USART1 else USART2

name: duml_crc16_fix
note: recompute DUML CRC16 (seed 0x3692) over pkt[0..len-3] and store at tail

name: duml_set03_id43_fwd
note: dispatch key 0x43030009: rewrite receiver type to 2 then 1, fix CRC, packet_send (fan-out of FC OSD push)

name: duml_set03_id42_fwd
note: dispatch key 0x42030009: rewrite receiver type to 4 (gimbal), fix CRC, packet_send

name: iwdg_init

name: fpga_bits_set

name: fpga_bits_clear
note: clear bits per record idx

name: fpga_bits_test
note: test bits per record idx; returns reg & mask

name: fpga_bit_records
note: 3-byte records [idx, fpga_reg, mask], 11 used

name: nullsub_1
note: empty stub; compiled-out log calls (strings Fpga Boot/Cfg remain in flash)

note: check FPGA reg0F b1, compare regs 0x09/0x08 with 2 host bytes, handshake; 4 ok, 6/7/8/9 fail, 2 -> reload

note: set reg0 b0 and wait for reg 0x8A[1:0]==1 (3x400 polls); returns 3 ok or 9

name: duml_enter_loader
note: set 0x00 cmd 0x07: receiver 9 writes OOXX to flash page 0x7400; receiver 0x13 (boards 4/5) enters FPGA upgrade

name: duml_update_confirm
note: set 0x00 cmd 0x08 (receiver 0x13): reply status and block size 0x200

name: duml_update_finish
note: set 0x00 cmd 0x0A (receiver 0x13): calls fpga_update_finish, reply status

name: flash_write_magic
note: flash write of 4 bytes at offset 0x7400 (helper 0x0800bc2c); returns 1 if all bytes written
